title: A Town That Changed
text:
This month's magazine has an article about a small town that changed its life. The town built a new park and opened a bicycle shop. Now more families come there every weekend.

The writer visited the town last spring. She talked to many shop owners, who were happy with the changes. One owner said that customers now stay longer and spend more money.

questions.text: When did the writer visit the town?
Why do more families visit the town now?
options: The writer asked them to come

questions.text: What can the reader infer about the shop owners?
options: They are unhappy with the changes
They are happy because they earn more

vocabulary.definition: a piece of writing published in a magazine or newspaper
an open green area where people can walk and relax
people who buy things from a shop
differences that make something new or different

paragraph_translations: W tym miesiącu w magazynie jest artykuł o małym miasteczku, które zmieniło swoje życie. Miasto zbudowało nowy park i otworzyło sklep z rowerami. Teraz każdego weekendu przyjeżdża tam więcej rodzin.

Autorka odwiedziła miasteczko zeszłej wiosny. Rozmawiała z wieloma właścicielami sklepów, którzy byli zadowoleni ze zmian. Jeden z nich powiedział, że klienci zostają teraz dłużej i wydają więcej pieniędzy.
